title: Preventive Maintenance 101: When to Schedule, When to React
description: The intervals that keep a truck earning, and the warning signs that mean you stop driving and call the shop.
body:
PLACEHOLDER COPY — the design handoff supplied this article's title and category only. Replace this body before launch.

A preventive schedule is cheaper than a tow. This article will cover the service intervals we recommend by duty cycle, the checks a driver can make on a walkaround, and the symptoms that mean a truck should come off the road now rather than at the next scheduled stop.
